description: Records and submits to management a disagreement with or doubts about one diagnosis reported by the listDiagnoses tool. Call this tool to question a diagnosis or its issue classification. Requires a reportID, issueID, catalogIndex (element identifier), engineID, and ruleID from listDiagnoses, and a reason explaining your concern. If your objection is more general than a single diagnosis, call requestFeature instead.

catalogIndex.description: Identifier of the issue-exhibiting element in the catalog of elements on the page (example: 372), as in the listDiagnoses output that showed the disputed diagnosis

engineID.description: Identifier of the rule engine that produced the disputed diagnosis (example: axe), as shown in the listDiagnoses output

issueID.description: Issue identifier (example: contrastPoor), as in the listDiagnoses output that showed the disputed diagnosis

reason.description: 20- to 1000-character explanation of why the diagnosis is disputed, evaluated by the reviewing manager

reportID.description: Identifier of the report (example: 260503T0432-x9z), as in the listDiagnoses output that showed the disputed diagnosis

ruleID.description: Identifier of the rule whose diagnosis is disputed, as shown in the listDiagnoses output (example: color-contrast); if that output shows null for the rule identifier, use its description of the violation instead

name: questionDiagnosis

date and time.description: UTC date and time when the response was generated, in ISO 8601 format.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of this response (timestamp and random suffix).

URL.description: URL of the Kilotest MCP server.

description.description: Explanation of what Kilotest does and how to use its tools.
